Pixel art for a 2D side-view mining game. Crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, every cell drawn as if on a 32x32 pixel grid. Limited dark palette: warm browns, grey-browns, charcoal and black, with warm orange-yellow lamplight highlights; ore colours: coal near-black with dull grey glints, silver pale blue-grey, gold warm yellow, crystal bright cyan. Flat front lighting, no vignette, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no outer frame. Original design, not based on any existing game, brand or character.
Sprite sheet tiles_rock.png: exactly 2 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells, edge-to-edge, no gaps or divider lines. Full-cell seamless textures. Square canvas.
